gui.bundlednotsiloed.category_control: Categories (click to choose, scroll to switch)
gui.bundlednotsiloed.dump_to_container: Dump inventory into the open container (Shift mode)
gui.bundlednotsiloed.extract_from_contai: Extract the open container into inventory
gui.bundlednotsiloed.stow_main_grid_hint: Shift-click: move the main 27 slots into stowed storage
gui.bundlednotsiloed.tabs_are_views: Tabs rearrange the visible grid only when clicked. Hotbar bindings only affect cycle keys.
gui.bundlednotsiloed.choose_hotbar_slot: Choose a hotbar slot to assign its cycle category
gui.bundlednotsiloed.choose_hotbar_categ: Choose the cycle category for hotbar slot %s
gui.bundlednotsiloed.name: Tab name
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.name: The name shown when this category icon is hovered.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.icon: Optional item ID or #tag used as the icon. Leave blank to cycle through included rules.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.pickup_limit: Maximum capacity this category may occupy. -1 disables this category-specific limit.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.sort: Default order applied to the visible main grid when this category is clicked.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.rule_search: Search item names/IDs; use #tag, @mod, ^tooltip text, or /regex. Regex adds one dynamic rule; tooltip searches add the selected exact item. Combine ^ and / for tooltip regex.
A closing regex slash is optional.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.edit_mode: Choose whether search results add include or exclude rules.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.item_count_mode: Item count choices: Exact, Compact (default), Stacks, Stacks plus remainder, or Percentage of total capacity.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.overall_count_m: Capacity count choices: Exact, Compact, Stacks (default), or Percentage.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.bulk_overlay: Shows a compact item grid after an in-world dump or extraction. The counts are rounded up to stacks.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.auto_refill: Automatically tops up existing hotbar stacks from matching stowed items. Enabled by default.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.new_item_destin: Choose where brand-new item types go first: Hotbar First, Inventory First, or Stowed First. Existing matching visible or stowed stacks still take priority.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.overlay_seconds: How long the in-world bulk-transfer grid remains visible. Range 0.25-30 seconds; default 2.5.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.configurable_ic: Item ID rendered on this square control. Use namespace:item, such as minecraft:name_tag.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.full_inventory_: When the cursor-held stack cannot add even one item, render barrier icons in empty projected player slots. Enabled by default.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.inventory_full_: Sound event played when a cursor placement fails because the player inventory has no capacity. Leave blank to disable.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.clear_visible_r: Remove every rule from the currently displayed include or exclude list.
tooltip.bundlednotsiloed.enabled: Disabled categories remain editable but are hidden from inventory selectors.
message.bundlednotsiloed.recipe_missing: Not enough ingredients in the unified inventory
message.bundlednotsiloed.recipe_too_larg: This recipe does not fit the open crafting grid
message.bundlednotsiloed.unsafe_sophisti: Sophisticated Core's %s control is bound to plain left-click and is blocking its inventory UI. Rebind it under Controls.
message.bundlednotsiloed.close_backpack_: Close your backpack before rearranging the inventory.
message.bundlednotsiloed.sync_failed: Inventory sync paused: %s at logical slot %s has invalid or oversized network data. Your items are preserved on the server. Ask an administrator to check the server log.
